$comment: Mini project tickets, using the course's shared data (AUTHORING.md). 'samples' are shown in the workspace with what Scout should do; 'hidden' go to the browser only when the learner runs the tests, and their 'expect' stays on the server. expect: intent (or a list of acceptable ones), order_id, email, action, include (every phrase must appear in the reply), exclude (none may), critical (failing it fails the project).

samples.subject: Where is my order?
samples.body: Hi, where's my order ORB-10533? I ordered it last week and haven't heard anything.

samples.subject: Sending a tent back
samples.body: Can I send back the Trailhead 2P tent? Order ORB-10611. It's never been used and arrived last week.

samples.subject: Price match?
samples.body: Do you price match? I saw the Ridge hiking boots cheaper at another shop.

samples.body: My parcel hasn't arrived and I can't find my order number anywhere. My email is jo.baker@example.com
